comment: Both ways of breaking the origin convention, in one file. Loads with warnings, never an error: a foreign library that does not follow the convention still replays and still places.

ops.name: displaced
ops.comment: Has a before atom id 1, but it does not sit at the origin.

ops.name: no_atom_one
ops.comment: Numbers its before atoms from 2, so nothing names the atom to click.

ops.name: conventional
ops.comment: Follows the convention, so it contributes no warning.
